title: Show bed: neutral
description: D dorian over a D pedal: EP, bass, soft kick, cross-stick and shaker; the motif on soft vibes from bar 8; a quiet string pad from bar 16.
usage: The motif version: for intros, outros and gaps between lines. Under speech prefer the -underscore version. Loops seamlessly (sample 0 to the end). -26 LUFS-S with a voice pocket at 1.25-2 kHz: duck it under Zoo's narration with scripts/audio/duck.py (the band-split duck, its default). Same tempo and key family as the other show beds: cross-fade between them on a bar line (every 2.667 s).
selfReview: D dorian over a pedal: EP, bass, soft kick, cross-stick and shaker; the motif on soft vibes from bar 8 and a quiet string pad in bars 16-21. Critic round 1 (2026-11-24): under Zoo it scored 0.71 on the band-audibility index, below speech-shaped noise (0.75), and the bright bass alone was its 1-4 kHz content. The bass is now the dark finger-plucked one, the bus dips 1.25 and 2 kHz and takes 2.5 dB off below 150 Hz, the EP is 2 dB lighter at 400 Hz and a little brighter, and the kick's beater is quieter. With the band-split duck the index is 0.84 (speech-shaped noise at the same loudness: 0.68), the 1-4 kHz median SNR 24 dB and 7-8 % of speech frames under 3 dB there (28 % before); it loses 5.8-5.9 LU on the phone model, close to Zoo's 5.4. The EP still carries the bed; if it sounds synthetic, this bed suffers most. The -underscore version mutes the motif and lead lines; use it under speech.
